title: Bauhaus motion reel — one dot through six techniques

source.author: @condzxyz
source.note: Remade from scratch in HyperFrames after the Bauhaus motion reel; structure and pacing follow it. The studio name, lines and on-screen numbers are ours; the numbers describe this composition (1600 particles, 45 tiles).

scenes: 00 the dot: squash and stretch on a sagging ground line, onion-skin ghosts
01 type: letters rise, cut to cream, the dot drops onto the i, variable-font wave, dive into the dot
02 shape: bauhaus tile grid explodes in from a zoom, shuffles, flips to truchet, falls away
03 dimension: 1600 dashes burst into a sphere, torus, ripple field and spiral
04 fluid: shaded metaballs splash, merge, divide into two, four and a row
05 data: rolling counters, energy line, live capsule bars, glitch out
06 identity: wordmark, dot, italic role and decoded meta line
notes: word1 and word2 each need a lowercase i: its dot is the orange ball.
